body: Hi Alberto, Just tried the portable version from your link to the nightly, here is what I did: I put a CR3 file and a DNG file in a folder, then I opened the ART UI and navigated to the folder. From the "film-strip" at the top of the UI, I double-clicked on the DNG file to load it into the editing window, and I then went up to the film-strip to right-click on DNG's thumbnail to select the rename option. The renaming of the DNG completed successfully with it open in the editor pane. I then double-clicked on the CR3 file thumbnail in the film-strip to load it into the main editing window, and I then right-clicked its thumbnail in the film-strip to rename, but I get the original issue: As a cross-check, with ART still open with the CR3 file loaded in the editing pane, I tried to rename the file outside of ART via native Windows right-click. A dialog box popped up to say the action could not be completed as the file was open in ART. Conversely, this was _not_ the case for the DNG. With it open in the editing window in ART, I was able to rename it via native Windows right-click without issue.
